# ConnectAlign

> ConnectAlign is a cloud-based, all-in-one SaaS platform for digital transformation that unites internal communication, document management, training, event management, and employee engagement in a single system. Developed by Utilwork Bilgi Teknolojileri (Istanbul, Turkey). The platform is bilingual (Turkish / English), GDPR and KVKK compliant, and accessible via web with iOS/Android mobile apps.

ConnectAlign (Türkçe): İç iletişim, doküman yönetimi, eğitim, etkinlik ve organizasyon yönetimini tek platformda toplayan bulut tabanlı kurumsal SaaS çözümüdür.

## Core Features

- [Document Management System](https://connectalign.com/features/document-management): Hierarchical category trees, role-based access control, advanced content search, audit trail, secure cloud storage.
- [Internal Communication](https://connectalign.com/features/internal-communication): Announcements, push notifications, targeted messaging and engagement channels.
- [Organization Management](https://connectalign.com/features/organization-management): Companies, departments, users and role-based authorization management.
- [Training & Development](https://connectalign.com/features/training-development): Video-based training content distribution for continuous employee development.
- [Dashboard & Reporting](https://connectalign.com/features/dashboard-reporting): Real-time analytics and graphical dashboards.
- [Event Management](https://connectalign.com/features/event-management): Corporate event planning, announcements and attendee tracking.
- [Digital Business Cards](https://connectalign.com/features/digital-business-cards): QR-code based digital business cards for staff.
- [Mobile Support](https://connectalign.com/features/mobile-support): iOS and Android apps with responsive web interface.
- [Security & Authorization](https://connectalign.com/features/security-authorization): Encrypted data storage, secure authentication, role-based permissions, ISO 27001 certified data centers.

## Plans

- Basic: up to 50 users, email support
- Pro: up to 200 users, priority support
- Enterprise: unlimited users, 24/7 dedicated support
